MASTER CYCLE - for Minecraft Java Edition 26.3
==============================================

This zip contains two files. Do NOT unzip them - Minecraft reads them as .zip.

  MasterCycle-resourcepack.zip  -> the 3D bike, textures and sounds
  MasterCycle-datapack.zip      -> riding, fuel, Sheikah Slate

1. RESOURCE PACK
   Minecraft main menu -> Options -> Resource Packs -> Open Pack Folder.
   Drag MasterCycle-resourcepack.zip into that folder.
   Back in Minecraft, move "Master Cycle" from Available to Selected -> Done.

2. DATA PACK
   New world:  Create New World -> Game tab: Allow Commands ON
               -> More tab -> Data Packs -> drag MasterCycle-datapack.zip
               onto the window -> move it to Selected -> Done -> Create.
   Old world:  Singleplayer -> select world -> Edit -> Open World Folder
               -> open "datapacks" -> drop MasterCycle-datapack.zip in.

3. PLAY
   Type in chat:   /function mastercycle:give_slate
   Right-click with the Sheikah Slate to summon the bike, right-click the
   bike to ride.  W/S throttle & brake, A/D steer, Ctrl+W boost,
   Space hop, Shift get off.  Refuel: right-click the bike holding coal,
   redstone, blaze powder or a nether star.  Shift+punch puts it away.

If a pack says "made for a newer/older version", you are not on 26.3:
press F3 in game and check the version on the top-left line.
